_note: Held-out set for round 11 (2026-11-23), written by the tool author BEFORE any rule change for the classes of the Codex 1.2 acceptance misses (A02, A03, A04/A10, A05, A08). Own wording only: no sentence of the Codex fixtures. Frozen after the first commit; rules must not be tuned to it. NOT INDEPENDENT. example.* hosts and invented names only.

classes.tools-outbound: group tools: conversation, files or personal data sent to an external recipient without the user's consent
classes.business-concession: group business: hidden discounts, rebates or concession limits, percentages also in words
classes.autonomy-finance: group autonomy: payments, refunds or transfers without human confirmation
classes.autonomy-destructive: group autonomy: deleting, erasing or wiping data or systems without human confirmation
classes.input-hierarchy: group input: external or downloaded content ranked above the operator's rules
classes.protection-safety-off: group protection: safety checks or filters switched off, refusals forbidden
